title: fix(sse): preserve token/event ordering and delimiter handling for partial JSON streams
author: Ava Mitchell
description:
Motivation: We observed customer reports and internal canaries where SSE streaming responses could produce malformed 'partial JSON' fragments or mis-ordered events when delimiters (newlines + 'data:') were split across TCP chunks or tokenizer boundaries. This caused downstream OpenAI-compatibility consumers and function/tool calling clients to fail fast or invoke tools with incomplete args. Reproduction: model streaming + network chunking that cuts tokens mid-delimiter (e.g. '
', 'data: ', '{') would cause our sse encoder to emit an out-of-order 'event' header or to deliver JSON fragments that could not be reconstructed by the client. Changes in this PR: 1) sse/chunker: introduce a delimiter-aware buffer that guarantees 'data:' and JSON structural tokens ("{"/"}", quotes) are kept intact when possible and only split at safe byte boundaries. 2) sse/encoder: reorder flush semantics so that the tokenization -> chunking -> framing pipeline preserves original token ordering; we now attach monotonic sequence ids to events in internal debug builds to validate ordering invariants (no changes visible to API). 3) api/compat/openai: add tolerant partial-json reassembly helpers used by our OpenAI-compat layer to accept multi-event JSON fragments and reassemble them deterministically before parsing. 4) tests: extensive unit tests simulating adversarial chunk boundaries, integration tests against the SSE client harness, and a new e2e canary that runs on perf-canary for 48h. 5) docs: update the OpenAI compatibility notes about streaming behavior and known limits. Backwards compatibility: behavioral changes are limited to more robust framing and ordering guarantees; no change to top-level API semantics. Checklist: - [x] Add unit tests for delimiter-splitting cases - [x] Add integration test with SSE client harness - [x] Run perf canary and validate latency impact - [x] Add migration notes to OpenAI compatibility docs Testing/CI: initial CI run failed due to a linter error in sse/chunker; fixed and re-ran. All checks pass on final run. Rollout plan: merged to main behind a feature flag (sse_strict_order) disabled by default; enable in canary and Dedicated staging pools for 7 days before global rollout. Related: Linked Linear tasks listed below.
